evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: None present. Rep moves directly to data collection without framing the 10-15 minute call or waiting for agreement.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: 'first name is Leslie and last name is long'; moving day: 'Friday, this coming Friday. Correct? September 25th'; route: 'address of the current house and for the new address'; size: 'What is the square footage? It is 1850'
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Rep correctly identifies 1,850 sq ft (at the threshold) and routes call to specialist: 'I have to transfer your call to a moving specialist that can handle this move.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep collects contact info and logistics, then transfers without probing concerns.
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Property type (house, one story), square footage (1,850), pickup address, two drop-off locations (house and storage unit) confirmed. Missing: number of rooms, walking distance from truck, additional rooms, special considerations beyond 'furniture and no personal belongings.'

top_strength: Jeline correctly identified a 1,850 sq ft move as appropriate for specialist routing and executed a clean handoff to a moving specialist rather than attempting to quote on an oversized move.
coaching_note: Before transferring out, ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — this intake call should surface the customer's agenda so the specialist inherits context, and it's required by Section 2 on all intake calls.
booking_note: Call ends mid-transfer to specialist with no confirmed booking; customer mentioned Friday September 25th but specialist was about to take over when transcript ends.
